description: This Dart file implements a Flutter widget 'WebViewScreen' that displays web content from assets using the webview_flutter package. It manages the WebView controller, loading state, and error handling for rendering an embedded web page within a Flutter app.

classes.name: WebViewScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a web view for a specified asset path.

classes.name: _WebViewScreenState
classes.description: State class managing WebViewController, loading state, and error handling for WebViewScreen.

methods.name: WebViewScreen
methods.description: Constructor for WebViewScreen, requiring an asset path.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the WebViewScreen widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the WebViewController and begins loading the web content.

methods.description: Attempts to load the HTML asset into the WebView, with fallback for asset loading errors.
